note: Descriptive contract only. The canonical executable configuration is train_qwen_live_grpo CLI; this JSON is not a loader.
rca_output: one physical line; service::fault_type::mechanism[::variant] roots separated by |

digital_twin.scope: all attributable observably affected services (alias-resolved) plus request paths and startup dependencies; unattributed symptom names reported
digital_twin.calibration: matched application/mechanism/variant/joint controls; no built-in qualified threshold
digital_twin.action_retry: fresh frozen reference plus same fault hypothesis
digital_twin.recovery: all observed symptoms cleared and SLA satisfied; restoration transition recorded separately
digital_twin.phase_window: each phase measured inside its own window; workload phase >= 2 * Prometheus scrape_interval + 5s (150s at a 1m cadence); lookback never widened

legacy_paths: agents/, training/, and old standalone debug scripts are not the canonical live training implementation
